id: title:arnohillen:reuse established freeform tags across scans

review.posthog_relevance: Replay Vision backend: enriches call-scanner workflow with bounded, transient freeform tags to support LLM invocation without persisting transient context.
review.reason: Adds bounded retrieval and injection of freeform tags to the call-scanner workflow, including implementation of recency and size caps, transient storage, and prompt context injection. This establishes a substantive, bounded capability for the Replay Vision backend.
review.uncertainty: Tier 2 assigned based on implementation and checks; tier 3 not assigned as broader systemic risk reduction or wider component impact is not demonstrated. No adoption or incident avoidance inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are supported. No tier assignment is made; this is an observation-only pass.

observations.behavior: Adds imports and a new activity, _inject_known_freeform_tags, to call_scanner_provider.py.
observations.posthog_connection: Replay Vision backend: this activity is invoked during the call-scanner workflow, potentially enriching the scanner with recent freeform tags before LLM invocation.

observations.behavior: Adds a 30-day, 300-row, 30-tag, 60-char, 5-word cap and a helper to load and filter freeform tags, then injects them into the scanner.
observations.posthog_connection: Replay Vision backend: this hunk implements the bounded retrieval and ranking of historical freeform tags, establishing a deterministic, bounded context for the next scan.

observations.behavior: Adds a known_freeform_tags field to ClassifierScanner, excluded from persistence, and its use in prompt_context.
observations.posthog_connection: Replay Vision backend: this field carries transient, scan-specific context without persisting it, supporting the bounded, non-leaky design.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only test code. No production implementation, configuration, or shared utility changes are supplied. Tests alone cannot establish tier, adoption, or benefit. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds pytest tests for freeform tag loading and injection, including checks for recency, caps, instruction-shaping, and failure handling.
observations.posthog_connection: These checks could support the reliability and safety of the replay vision scanner's freeform tag handling, but without the corresponding production implementation, no tier can be assigned.
